scope: Code inspection and selected public aggregate result tables only. No advertised portable fitting/replay closure, no source inputs or individual records. Original bytes preserved from previously checked public archives; current local-file hash also checked where present. No new model fit/download.

current_roles: Separate within-woman concurrent depressive-symptom prediction beyond demographics and measured recent IPV; PHQ-9 score, not diagnosis or a causal mediation test.
Observed actual2023-to2024interview-year transport in different cohorts, including new-PSU and endorsement-domain sensitivities; no within-person prognosis or pandemic effect.
COVIDiSTRESS2020 female perceived-stress feasibility/prediction sensitivity; six overlapping country contexts. PSS measures perceived stress rather than clinical anxiety/depression.
Separate representation-learning comparison with simple algorithms; no violence exposure, personal justification or brain measurement in these respondents.

Separate Global Flourishing Study women: symptom burden, COVID-related bereavement, follow-up selection and contextual prediction. Distinct participants from national attitude surveys and ENDES; not evidence of an individual norms-to-symptoms pathway.
Separate GFS algorithm/representation-learning comparison including nested country validation; neural/embedding fitting requires provider respondent inputs.

Separate UN Women rapid-gender-assessment symptoms and self-reported violence/broad mental-health impacts, including a Colombia exploratory analysis. These outcomes/populations differ from attitudes and from prospective IPV incidence.

excluded: raw/provider source downloads and source inputs
neural/other fitted model states and model_records
